reviews.t: Heavy duty; Professional Quality; Easy Install
reviews.x: This holder is bigger than it looks on screen, which is a good thing.  Made with heavy metal and very good paint.  To install into a stud will need two screws (the holes a large for bigger screws).  Mounting in drywall use toggle bolts. The included plastic anchors and screws are not sufficient.  Great place for hot irons and storage when not in use.

reviews.t: Need better screws & drywall insert
reviews.x: Product is great but don't use the drywall inserts or screws. Both not good quality and will not hold. Just put in good screws and it's great!

reviews.t: I wish I had bought this sooner
reviews.x: I wish I would have bought this years ago. I attached it to my bathroom wall and keep my hairdryer and my two straighteners in it. It's really nice not to have to worry about what I am setting my hot tools on. It seems to hold the heat well too, so it's not transferring onto the wall that it is attached to.

reviews.t: Great product!!'
reviews.x: Love it!!!! Perfect for what I needed it for. It supports my flat iron, my wand, and my blow dryer all @ the same time, and it's not bulky... Great buy!

reviews.t: Excellent organizer you won't ever want to live without.
reviews.x: Supreme quality holder- but have some toggles (plastic expandrs that go in the wall and hold the screw) ready as back-up because the ones supplied don't work. Be sure to measure the width of your implements to make sure they fit the holders. If you prepare you're going to be so so happy at the sudden space you gain on your counter. I will never live without one of these things again.

reviews.t: Make sure this is the size holes you need.
reviews.x: This didn't work out well for me.  The curling irons fall all the way through it and my hair dryer is too large for the biggest hole.  Check measurements before buying.  It is high quality so if this is the size you need, it's a good purchase.

reviews.t: Workhorse Salon implement holder
reviews.x: Very sturdy and well made, better than expected. It is made of heavy guage steel and has an excellent gloss black paint job. Nothing cheap here. I expect to get years og service from mine.

reviews.t: They are great kids, but not always the gentlest on things ...
reviews.x: I have only had this for a few days and have not yet mounted it on the the wall, but it appears to be very well made and tough which is what I was looking for since this is going to be used by a teenager and pre-teen pair of girls. They are great kids, but not always the gentlest on things that they are using, so I am hoping that it will be teen proof, if there is such a thing!

reviews.t: Check measurements to be sure smallest hole isn't too small for you.
reviews.x: Perfect to hold my curling wand, straightener and blow dryer. Smallest hole is very small so either need to put in my straightener open or will only hold the wand with one of the narrowest barrels.

reviews.t: Very Handy
reviews.x: I purchased this item to mount to the side of my makeup vanity. My husband was able to mount it with the included hardware without any problems. I love how it makes my makeup station look so professional and it also keeps my hair appliances nearly out of the way and not sitting on top of my vanity taking up valuable space. It is heat resistant so I don't even have to wait until my irons cool down, just style my hair and holster it. I love this product...I do wish I had gotten one with more holst

reviews.t: Put your dryer handle in instead of the nozzle
reviews.x: I love this thing. I have my blow dryer, 2 inch curling iron, and 1 inch curling wand in it. I put my dryer in so that the HANDLE is in the hole rather than the nozzle and that allows both my dryer and my 2 inch curling iron to be in this thing (though my SO had to take the cover off the plug to fit it through and then put the cover back on). It's a good sturdy metal so I'm not afraid to put hot tools in it. If the middle sized one were just a quarter inch larger I think it would be perfect.

reviews.t: Very heavy metal
reviews.x: product came quickly.  Very heavy and sturdy, daughter in law had us build a shelf unit for her and we used this (and a couple other things) and the girls that worked with her wanted husband to build them one so we bought another, the price is high though and two of the three girls felt this wall mount was too expensive.  All we asked was that they pay for these.  Again they are very heavy.  The biggest one does not hold large blow dryer but does hold the smaller ones.

reviews.t: Perfect for the job!
reviews.x: Looks good!  Solid metal. Easy to mount.  Arrived fast and packaged well.  Suggest having a fairly long Phillips head screw driver available. The center mount area is somewhat deep.

reviews.t: It's sturdy and has a nice design
reviews.x: It's sturdy and has a nice design.  I use the larger holder for my blow dryer, the medium one for my 1.5 inch curling iron and the smallest hole for my straightening iron.  I only put one side of the straightening iron in the small hole so it doesn't slip all the way through.  I placed a small hook on the wall near the mount to hang the cords on. Only 4 stars because the screws that came with it to mount it to the wall were REALLY soft and we completely demolished the screw heads screwing them i

reviews.t: I ended up super-gluing a bottom onto that hole & now it's perfect. For anyone considering doing that
reviews.x: Attached this to the side of my vanity & freed up a whole drawer that held my blow dryer, flatiron & curling iron!  Taking off one star because the flatiron won't work (it slides all the way through). You can put one side of the flatiron through & that works but looks ugly. I ended up super-gluing a bottom onto that hole & now it's perfect. For anyone considering doing that, I used the little round metal thing that's made as a door-opener for sliding closet doors. A couple of buc

reviews.t: Did not recieve the correct product.
reviews.x: Had I received the correct product I might have been able to leave a good review. Rather then the wall mount one I ordered I received one that had a stand and due to the way it was made could not be mounted on the wall. It wasn't even made the same way. I was very disappointed. I did return it and get refunded but when I ordered it it was because I needed it for my new bathroom. I'll probably try reordering it again to see if I actually get the product I wanted.

reviews.t: Perfect for what I needed
reviews.x: Very well made. Exactly what I was looking for! Had to use other hardware but other than that it’s perfect!

reviews.t: It's looks Okay, but it doesn't seem particularly well-made
reviews.x: This seems like it's fairly sturdy (it weighs more than I think it would have to which concerns me about it staying on the wall, but drywall screws are provided and it would do fine when screwed into a stud), and it looks Okay for the most part, but it doesn't fit my tools as well as I'd expected, and it started getting several rust spots inside the bottom rim of the compartments after sitting on the counter for just a few days before I hung it up. This isn't the biggest deal in the world (I jus

reviews.t: Very Sturdy Holder
reviews.x: Bought this product with confidence based on previous reviews I read on here and glad I did as my significant other loves it! This is definitely a heavy duty mount and the high-grade steel adds some weight. If you aren't mounting to studs, be sure to get your own screws and anchors as the included ones are flimsy. I ended up mounting right to the stud with my own screws and it holds perfectly.

reviews.t: Fantastic
reviews.x: Love this product!! It holds my hairdryer and straightener perfectly! It's super well made and heavy material quality. The company had fast service and a great buy! I got everything I asked for. I should've got one of these sooner. Super easy to install and convenient to use instead of constantly putting them wrapped up under cabinet after use. I just throw it in the holster and go.

reviews.t: ... too small for my hair dryer (which is a pretty basic size) but it's so well made I decided ...
reviews.x: The dryer side of this holder was much too small for my hair dryer (which is a pretty basic size) but it's so well made I decided to keep it for my curling irons alone.  The metal is solid and the finish is great...it should hold up forever.  I initially contacted the company to return the item and they were fast and helpful, but as I said I plan to keep it anyway.

reviews.t: Handy to have...
reviews.x: This does the job of holding my hair dryer and curling brush.  We had to modify it for the curling brush.  We cut a circular piece of wood and hammered it into the bottom of the second largest tube.  That way the curling brush wouldn't fall through.  It's perfect now. I keep a brush in the small tube.  Debi B.

reviews.t: It is made of metal so it is very sturdy and won't break over time like a plastic one ...
reviews.x: This was just what I needed! It takes up such little space and stores all my hair tools. I even used that the space in between the 3 tubes to store a fourth hair tool. It is made of metal so it is very sturdy and won't break over time like a plastic one would. Incredibly happy with this purchase

reviews.t: Awesome product, one small con
reviews.x: Awesome product however it doesn't have a bottom to catch my curler and straightener so I have to wrap the cords around them a few times so they don't fall through, no big deal though still like my product!

reviews.t: Worked great for my wife's stuff
reviews.x: Worked great for my wife's stuff.  I did not use the drywall hangers it came with.  Those were pretty flimsy. I used better ones.  Good quality otherwise.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the holder's heavy-duty, sturdy metal construction and quality paint finish.
Many reviewers warn that the included screws and drywall anchors are inadequate and recommend using better hardware or toggle bolts.
Several reviewers note that the smallest hole is too small or that flatirons/curling irons slip all the way through, so measuring beforehand is advised.
Reviewers commonly report it holds a blow dryer, straightener, and curling iron/wand together and frees up space on vanities and walls.
A few reviewers mention the price is high.
